item.title: Bridging the Gap: Twenty-five Years of the Sport Marketing Association
item.content:encoded:
This special issue commemorates twenty-five years of the Sport Marketing Association. The issue brings together research that reflects on the association's evolution, contributions to the field, and future directions in sport marketing scholarship.

Appel publié par Sport Marketing Quarterly. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
